scope: Three illustrative independent episodes of the same fixed CEM32 candidate12 policy on TRAIN128. These are not formal-panel results.
opening_title: 最新横向修正策略｜攻击、目标与失败对照
opening_lines: 同一固定策略、三个独立来球；完整Go2、PiPER与羽毛球拍。
TRAIN128：空中拍线19次、接触后恢复12次、攻击7次、完整0。
侧视与俯视显示原生全身动作、接触点和真实首次落点。
closing_title: TRAIN128完整成功0｜仍需联合改进
closing_lines: 攻击并恢复的案例落点偏远；目标命中案例速度不足。
拍框失败按实际记录保留，三个回合没有拼成一次成功。
高度规划训练正在运行，本视频未声称其已有性能结果。
evaluation_footer: 同一固定策略TRAIN128｜空中19、条件恢复12、完整0｜非正式A/B
caveats: Actual native50Hz whole-body poses and exact contact snapshots; no generated or interpolated motion.
The source evaluator reads only the frozen TRAIN cases, with zero reset noise. Formal A/B cases are not represented here.
All cases use policy SHA256 51a8b19b17e19e60bd7482c7bcb7ed1d4e8b7f50b9317cac3c49007089e8b62d. Case selection illustrates failures, not an independent performance claim.
Terminal pictures use the last valid50Hz sample, not a fabricated exact terminal pose.
Full TRAIN128 aggregate: air19/128, conditional recovery12/19, attack7, target1, complete0, numerical failures0.
The concurrently running CEM33 height-planning policy is not represented in these completed CEM32 trajectories.
